terra.problem: The holiday-rush comparison doesn't match the action of the earth being populated, so the joke doesn't land.
The block-party comparison doesn't match the earth being populated, and it's unclear why a city would barely cover a block party.
Saying a man who plants vines is planning to be around a while assigns Noah an intention the text doesn't give.
The claim that olive groves are all over the Bible is a Bible fact from outside the passage and needs a reference.
Verse 27 says 'may Canaan be his servant,' not that Canaan will be Japheth's servant. It also leaves the referent of 'his' open.
